camel_example: aliyun esa ListOriginRules --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234567890123 --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --ConfigId 352816096980000 --ConfigType global --SiteVersion 1 --RuleName test
description_zh: 查询多条回源规则配置
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-origin-rules --site-id 1234567890123 --config-id 352816096980000 --config-type global --rule-name test --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --site-version 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOriginRules

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:
global: Query global configurations.
rule: Query rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If not specified, both global and rule configurations are returned without distinction
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：
global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置。

该参数可以不传，不传时不区分全局或者规则配置
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1。不传时默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500。不传时默认500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. You can query global or rule configurations based on this parameter. Valid values:

global: Query global configurations.
rule: Query rule configurations
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：

global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置

DnsRecord.description_en: The rewritten DNS resolution record for back-to-origin requests
DnsRecord.description_zh: 改写回源请求的DNS解析记录

Follow302Enable.description_en:
The back-to-origin 302 redirect follow switch. Valid values:
on: Enable.
off: Disable
Follow302Enable.description_zh:
回源302跟随开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Follow302MaxTries.description_en: The maximum number of 302 redirect follows. Valid values: 1 to 5

Follow302RetainArgs.description_en:
The switch for retaining original request parameters. Valid values:
on: Enable.
off: Disable
Follow302RetainArgs.description_zh:
保留原始请求参数开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Follow302RetainHeader.description_en:
The switch for retaining original request headers. Valid values:
on: Enable.
off: Disable
Follow302RetainHeader.description_zh:
保留原始请求头开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Follow302TargetHost.description_en: The back-to-origin host after 302 redirect modification

OriginHost.description_en: The HOST carried in the back-to-origin request

OriginHttpPort.description_en: The origin server port accessed when using the HTTP protocol for back-to-origin
OriginHttpPort.description_zh: 使用HTTP协议回源时访问的源站端口

OriginHttpsPort.description_en: The origin server port accessed when using the HTTPS protocol for back-to-origin
OriginHttpsPort.description_zh: 使用HTTPS协议回源时访问的源站端口

OriginMtls.description_en:
The mTLS switch. Valid values:
on: Enable.
off: Disable
OriginMtls.description_zh:
mtls开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

OriginReadTimeout.description_en: The origin server read timeout period, in seconds

OriginScheme.description_en:
The protocol used for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:
http: Use the HTTP protocol for back-to-origin.
https: Use the HTTPS protocol for back-to-origin.
follow: Follow the client protocol for back-to-origin
OriginScheme.description_zh:
回源请求使用的协议。取值范围：
http：使用HTTP协议回源。
https：使用HTTPS协议回源。
follow：跟随客户端协议回源

OriginSni.description_en: The SNI carried in the back-to-origin request

OriginVerify.description_en:
The origin server certificate verification switch. Valid values:
on: Enable.
off: Disable
OriginVerify.description_zh:
源站证书校验开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Range.description_en:
Use range-based slicing for back-to-origin file downloads. Valid values:
on: Enable.
off: Disable.
force: Force enable
Range.description_zh:
使用range分片方式回源下载文件。取值范围：
on：开启
off：关闭
force：强制

Rule.description_en:
The rule content, which uses conditional expressions to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enable.
off: Disable
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The execution order of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber
